newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens sees higher restructuring charges.
newsitem.headline: Siemens sees higher restructuring charges.

text.p: German electronics group Siemens AG expects restructuring charges of around 900 million marks ($503.5 million) in the business year that ends on September 30, the company's finance chief Karl-Hermann Baumann said on Monday.
Baumann told reporters this compared to charges of 764 million marks the year before.
He added that the company expected additional revenue of up to 1.7 billion marks from the divestment of activities in the 1996/97 and 1997/98 business years.
Siemens has said in the past that it plans to divest activities with a total turnover volume of some 3.5 billion marks over the next 18 months.
